answer: One cargo, one voyage, one pair of hands. Each epoch, 36 wharves open one 25-minute voyage window: a claimant loads a grove-grown cargo seeded by the last block and the key, sails it to one wharf, unloading before three stranger witnesses, two wharves each. Entry locks 95 POA, +35 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 2,525 POA. One operator sails two at most, so ten fakes need five hands, ten voyages, thirty witnesses at once. A missed voyage burns 20; one cargo at two wharves burns both bonds. Sailing times match funding roots: ten wharves, one hand, one claim.
